summary: Transform your business strategy with our AI training for leaders. Learn how to leverage artificial intelligence to enhance decision-making and efficiency.
lede: Artificial intelligence strategy training helps business leaders identify valuable use cases and plan how to adopt AI across their organizations. It covers assessing data readiness, evaluating vendors and costs, and designing governance for risks such as bias, hallucinations, and unauthorized AI use. Participants also develop implementation roadmaps, performance measures, and plans for integrating AI into workflows.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for decision-makers and strategic leaders responsible for commissioning, governing, and scaling artificial intelligence initiatives within their organizations.
modules: Identifying and Prioritizing AI Use Cases
AI Risk Management and Algorithmic Governance
Evaluating AI Vendors and Technology Partners
Change Management and AI Workforce Integration
AI Strategy Synthesis and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Prerequisite Knowledge: Working knowledge of organizational strategy, business operations, and basic IT infrastructure. No prior coding, programming, or advanced data science experience is required. Familiarity with basic financial metrics (ROI, TCO) is recommended. Technical Requirements: A laptop with standard office software (Excel/Google Sheets) for utilizing financial dashboards and strategic templates. Access to a modern web browser for conceptual demonstrations of AI interfaces.
